coverage_questions: The paper does not provide Supplementary Table S3, Supplementary Fig. S4, or task-specific prompt templates; exact sequence-only deployment serialization and task-specific field values remain unspecified.
The 23 downstream tasks are described collectively rather than as separate input specifications, so this reconstruction groups their shared sequence-only fine-tuning/evaluation path.
The paper reports three OmniNA parameter scales but the atlas names only OmniNA and OmniNA-1.7B; the generic OmniNA trajectories therefore cover the documented shared architecture.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog contains probabilistic sampling but no beam-search or deterministic sequence-search primitive. The paper explicitly specifies beam search for generation.
The catalog has no operation for evaluating autoregressive target log-likelihoods and computing their paired difference between two aligned sequences.
